payload.zone_owner: agents-architect -> agent-father (system-auditor/flow data_stale check + SLA config)
payload.problem: data_stale SLA is one-size-fits-all. BCTC is quarterly; prices/foreign-flow/FX are per-tick but only during the VN trading window (02:00-08:59 UTC, Mon-Fri). A 360-min (or per-minute) threshold mis-fires on (a) quarterly sources off-season and (b) any per-tick source while the market is closed.
payload.proposed_fix: Make data_stale cadence-aware: (1) BCTC and other filing-cadence sources get a cadence model (quarterly/event-driven), not a minute SLA. (2) price/foreign-flow/FX staleness is gated on market-open status -- suppress when VN market is closed (weekend / outside 02:00-08:59 UTC). Drive thresholds from an explicit per-source SLA SSOT, not a hardcoded constant.
payload.relation: Sibling of repair_task_request:system-auditor:A-01-EXPECTED-SET (wrong-baseline) within sprint AUDITOR-NO-DESTRUCT / FLEET-HOST-SAFETY. Common root: detector checks need the correct per-target baseline (intended runtime set; per-source cadence), never a superset or a single global threshold.
